prompt-admin.alert.allStopped: "On for everyone" has stopped: the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now, and no session (the listed ones included) gets anything injected. It resumes by itself once reading works again; to pilot meanwhile, switch to list mode.
prompt-admin.alert.degradedExpected: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform itself ({problem}): the startup core used is only a reported text whose hash equals the "expected hash", not checked by the control plane. An admin computes the expected hash herself and enters it ({hint}); after an L1 update it must be entered again. This alert goes away once the control plane's service account can read the organisation's platform.{none}
prompt-admin.alert.degradedNoExpected: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform itself ({problem}), and no expected hash has been entered: no reported text is adopted and a pilot list cannot be switched on. Run {hint} yourself to compute the hash, then enter it.
prompt-admin.alert.degradedNone: No node has reported a text matching the expected hash yet: the listed sessions have no org layer for now.
prompt-admin.alert.expectedDiffers: The expected hash entered differs from the L1 text the control plane read itself (what the control plane read counts now; the expected hash plays no part): if L1 was updated, update the expected hash too, so it still works when the control plane cannot read.
prompt-admin.alert.expired: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now ({problem}): sessions keep using the copy it last checked (v{version}, read {when}, out of date). Texts nodes report do not replace it; "on for everyone" does not apply until reading works again.
prompt-admin.alert.nodeChurn: The startup core node "{label}" reported changed {n, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} within 24 hours
prompt-admin.alert.nodeMismatchExpected: The startup core node "{label}" read does not match the expected hash and was not adopted: if L1 was updated, the expected hash needs updating (compute it yourself, never copy a hash a node reported); sessions keep using the text that matches the expected hash
prompt-admin.alert.nodeRefused: The startup core node "{label}" reported was not adopted: {problem}
prompt-admin.alert.nodeRefusedDefault: it differs from what the control plane read
prompt-admin.alert.oldCore: The org startup core fetched is still the old version (it does not know the "{mark}" marker): only the pilot sessions on the list get it injected; "on for everyone" waits until L1 switches to the short core.
prompt-admin.alert.pilotTooMany: The list covers {people} people, over the limit of {max} while the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform: make the list smaller.
prompt-admin.apply.codex: Codex adds the new text to the thread at the next process start; no compaction needed
prompt-admin.apply.fresh: The experimental switch is on: it takes effect when the process restarts at the next turn
prompt-admin.apply.noChannel: This engine has no system-layer channel
prompt-admin.apply.notStarted: The conversation has not started yet: the first turn starts with it
prompt-admin.apply.off: The layered prompt is not enabled for this session
prompt-admin.apply.sidecar: An ask-only side branch is not compacted on its own
prompt-admin.core.noPlugin: No plugin that provides the organisation's startup core is enabled
prompt-admin.core.noReadPath: The control plane has no way to read the startup core (the plugin that provides it gives the control plane no read interface)
prompt-admin.core.notRead: The control plane has not read the organisation's platform yet
prompt-admin.core.offNoRead: While the layered prompt is off the control plane does not read the organisation's platform; it reads once when it is switched on
prompt-admin.effect.afterCompact: New conversations get it at once; a conversation already under way keeps the system prompt {engine} recorded when it started, and only takes the new text after its context is next compacted{apply}. After an update of the org startup core, it comes only after the process restarts by itself and the context is compacted.{off}
prompt-admin.effect.afterCompact.applyBu: — you can click "Compact and apply now"
prompt-admin.effect.afterCompact.offToo: The same holds once the layered prompt is enabled.
prompt-admin.effect.codex: Your change takes effect at the next turn: the process restarts and resumes this conversation, and the new text is added to the thread as a developer message (a new conversation starts with it). After an update of the org startup core, the new version comes with the process's next natural start.
prompt-admin.effect.fresh: The experimental switch is on for this session: the system prompt is rendered afresh at every request, so your change takes effect at the next turn (the process restarts and resumes this conversation). The cost of this switch on long sessions has not been measured.
prompt-admin.effective.notStarted: The conversation has not started yet: the first turn starts with it.
prompt-admin.effective.off: The layered prompt is not enabled for this session.
prompt-admin.effective.stale: Pending (until compaction): this conversation's system layer is still an earlier version; it is replaced once the context is compacted.
prompt-admin.effective.staleCodex: Pending: this conversation's system layer is still an earlier version; it is added to the thread at the next process start.
prompt-admin.effective.unconfirmed: Not in effect / not confirmed: the node has not reported that this conversation carries the layered prompt (a conversation started before it was enabled waits for a compaction; each turn still carries the full collaboration notes).
prompt-admin.effective.yes: In effect: the node reported that this conversation's system layer is this text.
prompt-admin.error.allOldCore: The org startup core fetched is still the old version: its text does not know the "{mark}" marker and would still make every session print the boot banner and sync the local files. It can be switched on for all sessions once L1 switches to the short core; for now a pilot list can be used
prompt-admin.error.allUnverified: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform itself ({problem}): there is no authoritative startup core, so it cannot be switched on for all sessions — texts nodes report are unchecked and allow a pilot list only. Switch it on for everyone once the control plane's service account can read the organisation's platform
prompt-admin.error.applyBusy: The last "Apply now" still has {n, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} waiting or being compacted: wait for it to finish, or cancel what is waiting first
prompt-admin.error.applyRetry: {error}: get a new estimate, then confirm
prompt-admin.error.expectedRequired: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform itself ({problem}): a pilot list first needs the "expected hash" — the SHA-256 of the text of startup core {doc}, computed by an admin herself ({hint}); only a reported text with that hash is adopted
prompt-admin.error.layersOff: The layered prompt is not enabled: there are no sessions to apply it to now
prompt-admin.error.nodeNone: This node has no report on record
prompt-admin.error.notOwner: Only the session's owner can see or change its prompt
prompt-admin.error.orgRefused: Startup core: {why}. Refused; sessions use the version the control plane read
prompt-admin.error.orgTooLarge: The startup core's text is too large
prompt-admin.error.orgWrongDoc: Not the startup core document the control plane is configured with
prompt-admin.error.pilotTooMany: While the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform itself, the list may cover at most {max} people (the members named, plus the owners of the sessions named); it covers {people}. Make the list smaller, or let the control plane's service account read the organisation's platform
prompt-admin.error.residentPrompt: A resident Agent's prompt is changed on its own settings page ("Prompt")
prompt-admin.error.sidecarPrompt: An ask-only side branch's prompt cannot be changed
prompt-admin.error.tokenMissing: Confirming "Apply now" needs an estimate first (send the token the estimate returned)
prompt-admin.error.tooLong: The whole system prompt would be {after} characters, over the limit of {max}: shorten the notes or switch off optional sections
prompt-admin.log.copySame: Same as the copy the control plane last checked (the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now)
prompt-admin.log.expectedMatch: The hash matches the expected hash an admin entered: this text is used (the control plane did not read L1 itself)
prompt-admin.log.expectedNoLonger: After the expected hash changed, the text this node reported no longer matches: not adopted
prompt-admin.log.expectedNowMatch: After the expected hash changed, the text this node already reported matches it: adopted
prompt-admin.log.expectedSet: Admin {admin} set the expected hash to {sha}
prompt-admin.log.forgotten: What this node reported was cleared ({by})
prompt-admin.log.matchOwn: Same as what the control plane read
prompt-admin.log.nothingRead: This node did not read the text this time (the text in use is unchanged)
prompt-admin.log.ownFirst: The control plane read the text for the first time
prompt-admin.log.ownNew: The control plane read a new text
prompt-admin.log.stateCeiling: This node's text switched between "matches" and "does not match" {n, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} or more within an hour: further changes this hour are only counted, not logged one by one. {words}
prompt-admin.node.changed: Differs from v{own} the control plane read (the version is not behind but the text differs: it may have been altered)
prompt-admin.node.copyDiffers: Differs from the copy the control plane last checked (v{version}); the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now to check it, so it was not adopted
prompt-admin.node.expectedMismatch: Hash {sha}… does not match the expected hash {expected}… an admin entered: not adopted. If L1 was updated, an admin computes the new hash herself and updates the expected hash
prompt-admin.node.expectedMismatchShort: Does not match the expected hash an admin entered: not adopted
prompt-admin.node.noExpected: No admin has entered an expected hash yet: not adopted
prompt-admin.node.notCore: The reported text does not look like a startup core (no "## 规则" part or red lines section found): not adopted
prompt-admin.node.nothingRead: This node did not read the text this time
prompt-admin.node.olderVersion: Differs from v{own} the control plane read (the report is the older v{reported})
prompt-admin.note.forged: A line in the {what} starts with "{marker}": that is a marker of the prompt's layers and cannot be written in notes
prompt-admin.note.tooLong: The {what} may be at most {max} characters; they are {n} now
prompt-admin.notify.mismatch.body: It was not adopted; sessions keep using the text that matches the expected hash. If L1 was revised, compute and update the expected hash: run {hint} yourself and enter it under "Settings › AI prompts" — never take a hash a node reported. If L1 was not revised, some node read or reported a wrong text.
prompt-admin.notify.mismatch.title: A node reported an org startup core that does not match the expected hash
prompt-admin.off.acp: {engine} has no system-layer channel: its sessions get nothing injected (they rely on the local guide files only)
prompt-admin.off.disabled: The layered prompt is not enabled yet (an admin turns it on in "Settings · AI prompts")
prompt-admin.off.noAuthority: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now (no authoritative startup core): "on for everyone" has stopped and no session (the listed ones included) gets anything injected; it resumes by itself once the control plane can read again, or an admin can switch to a pilot list
prompt-admin.off.notListed: The layered prompt is only enabled for the sessions on the list for now, and this session is not on it
prompt-admin.off.oldCore: The org startup core this session gets is still the old version (it does not know the "{mark}" marker): "on for everyone" does not apply to it until L1 switches to the short core
prompt-admin.off.oldRunner: This session's node (Runner) is too old to support the layered prompt: it takes effect once the Runner is upgraded and restarted
prompt-admin.orgNote.expired: The org layer is out of date: the control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now, and this startup core is the copy it last checked (read {when}).
prompt-admin.orgNote.unverified: The org layer was not checked by the control plane: this startup core is the text a node (Runner) reported, and the control plane could not read L1 itself; it was adopted only because its hash equals the expected hash an admin entered.
prompt-admin.perTurn.branch.note: Only the Runner knows the branch and the directory, so this line stays in each turn.
prompt-admin.perTurn.branch.text: You are on your own branch <branch> in the working directory <directory>. Keep the deliverables and the evidence of verification; the task's lead reviews and merges them. Do not merge or delete anything automatically.
prompt-admin.perTurn.branch.title: Own development branch
prompt-admin.perTurn.task.none: No main task: no task data is added.
prompt-admin.perTurn.task.note: Added on the first turn only, marked as "not system instructions".
prompt-admin.perTurn.task.title: Task context
prompt-admin.queue.adminCancelled: Admin {admin} cancelled what had not started in this batch
prompt-admin.queue.idleTimeout: No idle moment came within 24 hours: it takes effect at the next compaction anyway
prompt-admin.queue.layersOff: The layered prompt was switched off
prompt-admin.queue.notConfirmed: The compaction ended, but the node did not report the new text in effect (the compaction failed, or the Runner is older)
prompt-admin.queue.ownerCancelled: The owner took it out of the queue
prompt-admin.queue.timeout: The compaction did not finish in 30 minutes
prompt-admin.queue.withdrawnJob: {why}: the compaction that had not started was withdrawn
prompt-admin.read.notCore: The text does not look like a startup core (no "## 规则" part or red lines section found)
prompt-admin.read.status: The document's status is {status}, not active
prompt-admin.read.tooLarge: The text is over the size limit
prompt-admin.token.changed: The sessions to compact changed since the estimate
prompt-admin.token.otherAdmin: This estimate token belongs to another admin
prompt-admin.token.unknown: This estimate token does not exist
prompt-admin.token.used: This estimate token has already been used
prompt-admin.verifyHint.none: (no plugin that provides the organisation's startup core is enabled)
prompt-admin.warn.expectedUnseen: No node has reported a text with this expected hash yet: until one does, the listed sessions have no org layer (only the "cannot be fetched for now" line). Runners report every 10 minutes; if it stays like this for a while, check whether the hash was computed correctly.
prompt-admin.warn.fresh: Experimental switch: Claude Code renders the system prompt afresh at every request (--system-prompt-snapshot off). Its cost and stability on long sessions have not been measured; it applies only to the sessions / members on its list.
prompt-admin.warn.pilotExpired: The control plane cannot read the organisation's platform now: the listed sessions get the copy it last checked (v{version}, out of date). The list may cover at most {max} people.
prompt-admin.warn.pilotOldCore: The startup core fetched is still the old version (it does not know the "{mark}" marker): the listed sessions get the long version's notes twice and still print the boot banner and sync the local files. Fit for a pilot only.
prompt-admin.warn.pilotUnverified: The org layer is not checked by the control plane: it cannot read the organisation's platform itself, and the startup core the listed sessions get is a text a node reported whose hash equals the expected hash (after an L1 update an admin must enter the expected hash again). Fit for a pilot only; the list may cover at most {max} people.
